response.aggregation_note_zh: total_potential_* 只計算每台家電最有效的一項建議（避免同一台家電重複計算）；comprehensive_* 則是所有建議都落實時的合計，數字會較大。

recommendations.title_zh: 冷氣每日使用超過 8 小時
recommendations.title_en: Air conditioner runs more than 8 hours a day
recommendations.reason_zh: 冷氣是租屋處最常見的高耗電來源，每多吹 1 小時，月用電量就會線性增加。
recommendations.reason_en: Air conditioning is the biggest electricity user in a rented room. Every extra hour of cooling adds to the monthly total almost linearly.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 設定 26-28 度並搭配電風扇或循環扇，睡前使用定時功能，可減少 1-2 小時運轉。
recommendations.suggestion_en: Set 26-28 °C with a fan or circulator, and use the sleep timer so the unit runs 1-2 hours less.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設每日可減少 1.8 小時使用（原 9.0 小時），每月 30 天。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes 1.8 hours less use per day (from 9.0 hours), over 30 days a month.

recommendations.title_zh: 冷氣機 是家中用電量最高的電器之一
recommendations.title_en: Air conditioner is one of the biggest electricity users at home
recommendations.reason_zh: 預估每月用電 243.0 度，占全家總用電 63.7%。優先改善這類電器，節電效果最明顯。
recommendations.reason_en: It is estimated at 243.0 kWh per month, 63.7% of the household total. Improving this appliance first gives the largest saving.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 縮短使用時間、改用高效率機種或調整使用時段（避開尖峰），只要能降低 15% 用電量就能看到明顯差距。
recommendations.suggestion_en: Use it for less time, switch to a more efficient model, or move usage off-peak - cutting just 15% already makes a visible difference.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設將此電器的用電量降低 15%（目前每月 243.0 度）。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes a 15% reduction for this appliance (currently 243.0 kWh per month).

recommendations.title_zh: 冰箱 是家中用電量最高的電器之一
recommendations.title_en: Refrigerator is one of the biggest electricity users at home
recommendations.reason_zh: 預估每月用電 93.6 度，占全家總用電 24.5%。優先改善這類電器，節電效果最明顯。
recommendations.reason_en: It is estimated at 93.6 kWh per month, 24.5% of the household total. Improving this appliance first gives the largest saving.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 縮短使用時間、改用高效率機種或調整使用時段（避開尖峰），只要能降低 15% 用電量就能看到明顯差距。
recommendations.suggestion_en: Use it for less time, switch to a more efficient model, or move usage off-peak - cutting just 15% already makes a visible difference.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設將此電器的用電量降低 15%（目前每月 93.6 度）。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes a 15% reduction for this appliance (currently 93.6 kWh per month).

recommendations.title_zh: 考慮更換為一級能效變頻冷氣
recommendations.title_en: Consider replacing it with: Grade-1 inverter air conditioner
recommendations.reason_zh: 目前 900W 的冷氣機每月約用 243.0 度；同類高效率機種約 700W。
recommendations.reason_en: The current 900 W Air conditioner uses about 243.0 kWh per month; an efficient unit of the same kind is about 700 W.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 以相同使用時數估算，較高耗能的舊機種可明顯降低用電量。 若日後需要汰換，可優先選擇此類機種，新機價格需自行評估是否值得。
recommendations.suggestion_en: At the same usage, an older inefficient unit uses noticeably more electricity. If this appliance needs replacing later, prefer a model like this; whether the price is worth it is your call.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設使用時數（每日 9 小時、每月 30 天）與目前完全相同，僅更換機種功率。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes identical usage (9 hours a day, 30 days a month) and only the appliance's wattage changes.

recommendations.title_zh: 考慮更換為筆記型電腦
recommendations.reason_zh: 目前 250W 的桌上型電腦每月約用 45.0 度；同類高效率機種約 65W。
recommendations.reason_en: The current 250 W Desktop computer uses about 45.0 kWh per month; an efficient unit of the same kind is about 65 W.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 同等工作時間下，筆電耗電通常僅為桌機的 1/3 至 1/4。 若日後需要汰換，可優先選擇此類機種，新機價格需自行評估是否值得。
recommendations.suggestion_en: For the same working hours a laptop typically uses a third to a quarter of a desktop's power. If this appliance needs replacing later, prefer a model like this; whether the price is worth it is your call.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設使用時數（每日 6 小時、每月 30 天）與目前完全相同，僅更換機種功率。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes identical usage (6 hours a day, 30 days a month) and only the appliance's wattage changes.

recommendations.title_zh: 考慮更換為一級能效變頻冰箱
recommendations.title_en: Consider replacing it with: Grade-1 inverter refrigerator
recommendations.reason_zh: 目前 130W 的冰箱每月約用 93.6 度；同類高效率機種約 90W。
recommendations.reason_en: The current 130 W Refrigerator uses about 93.6 kWh per month; an efficient unit of the same kind is about 90 W.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 變頻壓縮機可依負載調整轉速，較定頻機種省電。 若日後需要汰換，可優先選擇此類機種，新機價格需自行評估是否值得。
recommendations.suggestion_en: An inverter compressor adjusts its speed to the load, so it uses less than a fixed-speed unit. If this appliance needs replacing later, prefer a model like this; whether the price is worth it is your call.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設使用時數（每日 24 小時、每月 30 天）與目前完全相同，僅更換機種功率。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes identical usage (24 hours a day, 30 days a month) and only the appliance's wattage changes.

recommendations.title_zh: 冰箱為 24 小時運轉電器
recommendations.title_en: The refrigerator runs 24 hours a day
recommendations.reason_zh: 每日 24 小時、每月 30 天的運轉時間讓冰箱即使功率不高，月用電量仍容易進入前幾名。
recommendations.reason_en: Running 24 hours a day, every day, puts the refrigerator near the top of the monthly total even though its wattage is low.
recommendations.suggestion_zh: 設定冷藏 5-7 度、冷凍 -18 度，避免塞滿影響對流，並與牆面保持 5 公分以上散熱距離。
recommendations.suggestion_en: Keep the fridge at 5-7 °C and the freezer at -18 °C, do not overfill it, and leave at least 5 cm of clearance behind it for airflow.
recommendations.assumption_zh: 假設可降低該電器 10% 的用電量（以目前每月 93.6 度為基準）。
recommendations.assumption_en: Assumes a 10% reduction for this appliance, based on the current 93.6 kWh per month.

input_warnings.message_zh: 每日 24 小時幾乎是全天運轉，建議再用負載估算確認用電安全。
input_warnings.message_en: 24 hours/day means this appliance runs almost continuously; use the load estimate to confirm it is safe.

response.disclaimer_zh: 以上節電量與金額皆為規則式估算，實際節省效果會因機種、環境與使用習慣而不同，不保證可達成相同金額。
response.disclaimer_en: All savings are rule-based estimates. Actual savings depend on the appliance model, environment and habits, and are not guaranteed.
